rules.description: Serve index.md to Markdown-capable agents on the CV root
rules.expression: (http.host eq "sebastien.rigaux.be" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) in {"text/markdown" "text/markdown;q=1" "text/markdown;q=1.0" "text/markdown, text/html" "text/markdown,text/html" "text/html, text/markdown" "text/html,text/markdown" "text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9, */*;q=0.8" "text/markdown,text/html;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8" "text/markdown;q=1.0, text/x-markdown;q=0.9, text/plain;q=0.8, text/html;q=0.7, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0,text/x-markdown;q=0.9,text/plain;q=0.8,text/html;q=0.7,*/*;q=0.1" "text/markdown, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown,*/*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0,*/*;q=0.1"})

rules.description: Serve sibling Markdown exports without changing the public URL
rules.expression: (http.host eq "sebastien.rigaux.be" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path ne "/" and not http.request.uri.path contains "." and not http.request.uri.path in {"/fr" "/fr/" "/404" "/404/"} and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) in {"text/markdown" "text/markdown;q=1" "text/markdown;q=1.0" "text/markdown, text/html" "text/markdown,text/html" "text/html, text/markdown" "text/html,text/markdown" "text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9, */*;q=0.8" "text/markdown,text/html;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8" "text/markdown;q=1.0, text/x-markdown;q=0.9, text/plain;q=0.8, text/html;q=0.7, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0,text/x-markdown;q=0.9,text/plain;q=0.8,text/html;q=0.7,*/*;q=0.1" "text/markdown, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown,*/*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0, */*;q=0.1" "text/markdown;q=1.0,*/*;q=0.1"})
